summary: First full test after MVP build. 16 backend pytest tests written and all passing. Fixed one MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in POST /api/community/posts. Frontend end-to-end flows verified: register, login (admin + new user), dashboard tracker, journal, goals (with dialog), community post/like/comment, AI chat streaming (Claude Sonnet 4.5 replies in Romanian as Speranță), reset tracker (with confirm), profile, resources. JWT token correctly stored in localStorage.

minor.issue: Comment items include _id ObjectId in some deep paths; currently serialized OK because it's overwritten with id string, but general pattern (mutating dict then dropping _id) is fragile. Prefer excluding _id via projection.

issues: Very tall hero — the animated headline 'libertate' visibly clips off the bottom of the first fold on 1440x900 viewport (partially cut '__libertate__'). Consider shrinking title size or adjusting min-height.
'Cont creat. Bun venit în comunitate!' toast overlaps with the 'PANOUL TĂU / Salut, Maria.' heading on the top-right, could be nudged lower or into a corner.
Days number 'o' (0) shown in a very large decorative serif looks like the letter 'o' rather than digit — some users may confuse it. Consider a monospaced/tabular number style.

action_items: (Minor) Sidebar 'Deconectare' click did not clear localStorage token in one browser run — verify logout handler clears token and redirects.
(Design) Adjust landing hero sizing so the 'libertate' animated word doesn't clip on standard laptop viewports.
(Design) Reposition post-register toast to avoid overlapping page heading.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user reads token from cookie OR Authorization header — good, but no CORS credentials origin whitelist (CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec; browsers will reject cookies. Since frontend uses Bearer, it works, but this should be fixed for future cookie-based auth).

server.py create_post originally leaked ObjectId in response (fixed here by popping _id before spreading). Same pattern used in other endpoints — audit all endpoints that return `doc` after `insert_one` (goals, journal, comments, chat_messages) and ensure _id is popped. Currently they set doc['id'] then pop _id — OK, but create_post was the odd one out.
Chat history is rebuilt by string concatenation and re-sent as prompt every request — will hit token limits on long sessions. Consider using LlmChat session persistence or trimming history window.
No rate limiting or brute-force protection on /api/auth/login. auth_testing playbook expects lockout after 5 fails — currently absent.
bcrypt hash generation works and hash format is $2b$ (verified via admin login).
JWT_SECRET is committed in .env — fine for dev, but flag as rotate-before-prod.
server.py is ~590 lines — approaching size cap; consider splitting into routers per resource before adding more features.
test_credentials: admin@recovery.ro / admin123 verified. Freshly-registered users via /register work (unique email required).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed goals/journal/posts during pytest run (posts/goals deleted afterward). Created two throwaway UI users maria+ui<rand>@test.ro (still in DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py in /app/backend/tests covers auth, tracker, journal, goals, community, badges, chat streaming, chat history. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All previously passing. Sidebar nav data-testid pattern: nav-<label lowercased with spaces→dashes>. 'Asistent AI' => data-testid=nav-asistent-ai (not nav-asistent).
rca of the issue: POST /api/community/posts returned 500 due to unserializable ObjectId: motor's insert_one mutates the doc adding '_id' (ObjectId); the endpoint then spread `doc` into the response without popping _id, so FastAPI's jsonable_encoder raised TypeError. Fix: `doc.pop('_id', None)` before spreading. Retested — all community endpoints now 200.
